messages:
deploy-bot: Started canary rollout v3.12.4 -> runtime-serving cluster 'eu-west-1' - canary fraction 10%

allen (runtime): seeing early noise: slow tail latencies on canary hosts, investigating kernel selection.

maya (oncall): paging support and runtime oncall. paged by monitoring: 5xx spike + 95th latency jump. @allen can you confirm?

allen (runtime): looking. observability shows kernel_fallback_count rising on canaries. KPIs:
```
kernel_fallback: 120 -> 850
p50: 45ms -> 52ms
p95: 220ms -> 1.2s
throughput_per_host: -30%
```

incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered for oncall-maya - severity:high - incident id INC-20255

maya (oncall): @carla @sanjay joining. rolling canary stopped? deploy-bot: what's current status?

deploy-bot: Canary progression paused automatically at 10% due to regression alert. No further traffic shifts.

carla (sre): Customer-facing impact: support dashboards show errors from embeddings service for a handful of customers. Ryan pulled logs: AcmeCorp, NimbusAI saw elevated tail latency and 5xx for ~6 minutes.

ryan (support): Acme pinged support — they're seeing timeouts for embed calls. Severity P1 for their SLAs. They're on eu-west-1.

sanjay (infra): kernel fallback = runtime choosing CPU kernel due to missing optimized kernel for new quantized variant on canary nodes. The kernel migration logic mis-detected device capability after the model variant switch.

allen (runtime): reproducing locally. A race where the kernel selector hits a fallback path when cache warming hasn't completed. Batching also regressed because continuous-batcher queues stall when fallback toggles.

maya (oncall): Mitigation options: 1) flip canary kill-switch to route traffic back to stable, 2) toggle feature flag to force previous kernel, 3) rollback canary deploy. Recommend immediate kill-switch + prepare rollback.

carla (sre): I can flip kill-switch. Command:
```
redwood flags set canary_kill_switch=true --env=prod --region=eu-west-1
```

carla (sre): Done. Confirmed traffic diverted back to stable pool. Observability: p95 improving but still elevated on some sessions.

allen (runtime): continuing analysis. Found off-by-one in kernel table that mis-indexes optimized kernels after quantization metadata change. Patch ready, but needs a hotfix build. I'd prefer rollback to fully restore capacity quickly.

maya (oncall): Agreed. carla please initiate rollback and coordinate with deploy. deploy-bot do rollout cancel and rollback to v3.12.3.

deploy-bot: `redwood rollout cancel rc-3124 && redwood rollout rollback --to=v3.12.3 --confirm` started. Notifying release owner @lisa.

lisa (product): Noted. We're tracking impacted customers and will coordinate comms. Please add to incident page and tag for postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20255 updated: mitigation in progress. Handoff: maya -> allen for triage, carla -> lisa for customer comms. Next update in 10m or when rollback completes.

maya (oncall): Thanks team. timeline: kill-switch at +2m, rollback started at +6m. We'll keep this thread for timeline & post-incident notes. If rollback completes, call out residual kernel fallback metrics.
